avis.titre: Very moisturizing but not a miracle product
avis.texte: I HAVE used this off and on for a long time and it feels great but I must say it doesn’t give the tightening look you’d hope for as another reviewer stated. I was t planning on reviewing this but I wanted to inform you of a product that DOES work. It’s a face/neck serum from a company called Pureance and the product is “Cellular Restore Serum.” Is it pricey? Yes, but not outrageously. I put this on first and then the Gopire neck cream. I don’t always use it though because the serum is very moisturizing. Another thing I would add to this routine is one of those handheld face and neck massagers they sell here on Amazon. They cost around $30 and the one I got has 7 different lights for different effects. I use the red light for collagen stimulation. It has a 5 minute timer so I do 5 on my neck and then 5 on each side of my face. You are going up against gravity and I think it helps. Im 64 and since using the Pureance serum someone I hadn’t seen in almost a year thought I’d had a facelift! Another thing, you have to buy Pureance on their website and it’s a subscription which you can cancel or delay anytime. I had ordered the three package bundle to lower the cost but then they started sending 3 containers every month! So I called to cancel as I don’t use three jars in a month (one lasted over a month for me) and the woman talked me into pausing for a year and the. Only shipping one jar a month, which I can also pause if I get too much on hand. I actually started with the Pureance

left me with deep horizontal rings on my neck that made me look way older than I am. I started applying this goPure Neck Cream twice daily, smoothing it upward toward my jawline. Within a month, those deep lines look noticeably softer and shallow. The skin on my neck feels firmer and less "slack." It is rich but doesn't cause breakouts on my chest or clog my pores. Absolute lifesaver!

I noticed a huge difference in tightening. It did take a few weeks of consistent use to see results. I stopped using it for a few months for a cheaper product and my neck started to sag again. I switched back to this cream and my neck is tightening up. I will continue to use this cream because it obviously works. You don’t need to use a large amount. A little goes a long way. You just need to be consistent with it and patient.

avis.titre: Noticeable Results for a Smoother Neck!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the goPure Neck Firming Cream for a few weeks, and the difference is impressive! The cream has a nice, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. What really stood out to me is how much smoother and tighter my skin feels, especially around my neck and jawline, which is where I needed the most help. It's packed with skin-loving ingredients like retinol and vitamin C, and I love that it doesn’t leave a heavy residue. After just a couple of weeks, I can see a reduction in the fine lines and crepey texture that have been creeping up over time. My neck feels firmer and more youthful! For anyone debating on investing in an anti-aging product specifically for the neck, this one is worth it. It performs as well as some higher-end brands I've tried, but at a much more reasonable price point. I’ll definitely keep this in my skincare routine.
